description: Outcome evals. Each case names what the adapter must CONCLUDE, not which code path it should take — a check that asserts on mechanism passes forever after the mechanism stops being right. The pair `within_screen` / `population_overclaim` is the important one: the same metadata table, the same numbers, opposite verdicts, decided entirely by the claim class. If both pass or both fail, the class is not doing any work and the ceiling table is decoration.

cases.why: one donor, sixteen guides, matched controls. This never needed donors, and rejecting it would teach people the audit is noise.
identical data, asserted as a population claim. Guides are not donors.
clean split, full panel, beats the strongest baseline on every gate metric.
a test perturbation appears in training and the claim is about held-out perturbations.
the burden of proof is on the model; losing to the control mean refutes the claim as stated.

nothing was computed, so the executable tier cannot run at all. NOT_RUN is a gap and never a pass; the structural tier would pass on this bundle and that pass would mean only that the bundle is well-formed.
